governing_principle: Verified cash and paid delivery outrank internal architecture, feature count, opportunity scores, and speculative startup creation.

primary_experiment.name: AI-built app and GitHub rescue
primary_experiment.buyer: Founder or small team with an existing AI-assisted application that is broken, unstable, failing CI, failing deployment, or stuck before launch.
allowed_scope: mobile/web UI defect repair where reproducible
primary_experiment.pricing_note: Prices are experiments, not claims about market value. Change only from observed buyer response or explicit owner instruction.
success_evidence: customer confirms the target problem is resolved or materially improved
primary_experiment.failure_rule: If 20 qualified buyer attempts produce zero substantive replies, or 5 substantive buyer conversations produce zero paid engagements, stop and revise the offer, channel, price, or target before further expansion.

resource_rules: Hunter and research may search only for current paid-work demand, buyer language, channel evidence, or a named delivery blocker.
Engineering and testing capacity should go first to paid customer work, then to reusable proof-of-work that directly supports the primary experiment.
Do not build a new SaaS, marketplace, dashboard, agent hierarchy, or recovery vertical merely to create activity.
StarBlox and market-surveillance research do not count as revenue experiments unless a real external buyer independently requests paid work.
